<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="18" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="17" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="13" r="2.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <path d="M345 13 Q350 7 355 13" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="10" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <rect x="386" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header and progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="29,61 22,68 29,75" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="68" x2="40" y2="68" stroke="#4B4B4C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">SET UP YOUR TRIP</text>
    <text x="367" y="52" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">1 OF 3</text>
    <rect x="48" y="78" width="294" height="9" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="48" y="78" width="98" height="9" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="132" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Plan your language trip</text>
    <text x="24" y="161" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">Tell us where you’re going and we’ll</text>
    <text x="24" y="183" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">prepare useful words for your adventure.</text>

    <!-- Trip illustration -->
    <g>
      <rect x="296" y="125" width="64" height="52" rx="14" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
      <circle cx="328" cy="145" r="11" fill="#FFC800"/>
      <rect x="307" y="151" width="43" height="13" rx="3" fill="#1899D6"/>
      <rect x="313" y="146" width="31" height="8" rx="3" fill="#1899D6"/>
      <line x1="319" y1="151" x2="319" y2="164" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="338" y1="151" x2="338" y2="164" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Language selection -->
    <text x="24" y="222" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">What language will you use?</text>
    <rect x="22" y="238" width="346" height="78" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="22" y="236" width="346" height="78" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="39" y="248" width="71" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="42" y="251" width="22" height="48" rx="7" fill="#6195D3"/>
    <rect x="64" y="251" width="21" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="85" y="251" width="22" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="127" y="264" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">French</text>
    <text x="127" y="289" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Selected language</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="275" r="13" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="335,275 340,280 349,270" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    
    <!-- Destination -->
    <text x="24" y="351" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="24" y="372" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Add a city or destination</text>
    <rect x="22" y="384" width="346" height="54" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="22" y="382" width="346" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="409" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="416" x2="62" y2="423" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="75" y="415" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#9DAD88">e.g. Paris</text>

    <!-- Dates -->
    <text x="24" y="474" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">When are you traveling?</text>
    <g>
      <text x="24" y="499" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">START DATE</text>
      <rect x="22" y="507" width="164" height="53" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="39" y="524" width="17" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="39" y1="529" x2="56" y2="529" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="43" y1="520" x2="43" y2="527" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="52" y1="520" x2="52" y2="527" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="70" y="540" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#9DAD88">Select date</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <text x="204" y="499" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">END DATE</text>
      <rect x="202" y="507" width="166" height="53" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="219" y="524" width="17" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="219" y1="529" x2="236" y2="529" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="223" y1="520" x2="223" y2="527" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="232" y1="520" x2="232" y2="527" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="250" y="540" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#9DAD88">Select date</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Purpose chips -->
    <text x="24" y="598" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">What will you do there?</text>
    <text x="24" y="620" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose one to tailor your lessons</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="22" y="634" width="104" height="37" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="74" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Sightseeing</text>
      <rect x="134" y="634" width="92" height="37" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="180" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Dining</text>
      <rect x="234" y="634" width="87" height="37" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="277" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Business</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Continue -->
    <g>
      <rect x="24" y="700" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
      <rect x="24" y="698" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
      <text x="195" y="728" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="773" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change these details anytime</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="792" width="390" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="792" x2="390" y2="792" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <polygon points="46,810 56,802 66,810 64,810 64,822 48,822 48,810" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="51" y="813" width="10" height="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="56" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">HOME</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <circle cx="143" cy="811" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="143,804 145,809 151,809 146,813 148,819 143,815 138,819 140,813 135,809 141,809" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="143" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">LEARN</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <circle cx="247" cy="807" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="247" cy="820" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="247" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <rect x="327" y="802" width="18" height="17" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="333" cy="808" r="1.5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <line x1="337" y1="808" x2="342" y2="808" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="332" y1="813" x2="342" y2="813" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="336" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">MORE</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
